description: The figures an analysis of a company is computed from — revenue, other operating income, purchases, staff costs, depreciation, the financial result, income tax, the net result, equity, total and current assets, cash, trade receivables, current liabilities, trade payables, long-term debt — each with the accounts that make it. The movements are read over the period and the balances at its end; equity includes the result of the years not closed yet. Which accounts make each figure is written in the company's country pack and in no tool. Each row carries source: pack when the country pack defines the analysis; framework when it defines none and the figures are read by account type through the generic framework, which leaves out staff costs, the financial result and income tax because no account type tells them apart — say those are not read rather than zero. The figures are never to be guessed from account codes. Ratios — a margin, a current ratio, days of sales outstanding — are worked out from these, not stored. It prepares figures; it files nothing.

company_id.description: The company to work in. Ask list_companies if unsure.

from.description: First day of the period the movements are read on: revenue, purchases, the result.

to.description: Last day of the period, and the day the balances are read at: equity, assets, debts, cash.
